headline: You’re losing money by increasing size after losses

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: Sizing up after a loss cost you ₹1,05,732, leading to a loss of ₹1,95,375. Your win rate dropped to 28% compared with 39% otherwise.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry is your usual size.

averaging_down.note: Averaging down is worth watching as it cost you ₹35,792 in this period.

closing: Consider following the rule “After a loss, your next entry is your usual size” next month.
